messages:
Clara: Quick heads-up We're scheduled to lift the embargo for the 'Performance & Cost' post at 15:00 UTC but encountered a brand-safety flag in the press kit attachments. Need fast triage.
Ben: What was flagged?
Clara: One partner slide has comparative logos that look like endorsements. Partner legal flagged as potentially misleading for syndicated outlets.
Iris: Ugh. If syndicated sites pick that up we could get misquotes. I can scrub the slide and repush assets. How tight are we on time?
press-bot: Reminder queued: embargo_email_sender will fire at 14:30 UTC (in 20m).
Legal: Recommend we remove the slide and replace the asset with a 'partner attribution' image that uses only text. Also add a short clarification line in the press release about "partner-provided summary" rather than endorsements.
Design: I can recreate the image in 10 minutes. Do we want the text-only version or a neutral chart with no partner logos?
Clara: Go text-only for syndication-safe. We'll keep the logo chart in the locked press kit for registered partners only.
Social: If we switch assets, we need the new hero by 14:40 so scheduled social posts can reference the right image. I can hold posts if needed.
Ben: I'll pause the embargo sender until we confirm. Can someone confirm the updated CMS file name once pushed so I can attach it to the embargo email?
Iris: Replacing asset now. Filename will be: hero_opt_cost_textonly_v2.png. Pushing to assets and updating the blog metadata.
Clara: Also adding a one-line footnote in the post content: "Partner figures are summaries provided for context; raw partner datasets are not included for public distribution." Legal ok?
Legal: That wording is fine. Keep it short and non-technical.
press-bot: Action: embargo_email_sender paused by @Ben at 14:12 UTC.
Ben: Paused. I'll resume at 14:45 if all clears.
Iris: Asset uploaded and CMS metadata updated. Hero file: hero_opt_cost_textonly_v2.png.
Design: Confirmed image matches brand guidelines and has no external logos.
Social: Scheduling adjusted. Will queue posts referencing new hero at T+0 once you greenlight.
Clara: Final checklist:
- Legal wording added to post (done)
- Asset swapped and CMS updated (Iris)
- Embargo emails paused (Ben)
- Social schedule held/updated (Social)
Please react with :white_check_mark: when ready to resume.
Ben: :white_check_mark: resuming embargo send at 14:45 UTC unless other blockers.
Clara: Thanks all. We'll monitor pickup after lift and have a rapid response thread open in #press-watch.
Social: On standby 14:40-16:00 UTC for replies and amplification.
press-bot: Scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 14:45 UTC (in 33m).
